components.name: Audio interface
components.job: Listens to the pedal's outputs and plays into its input, for these tests

components.name: Guitar input
components.job: Buffers the guitar, with its instrument/line switch

components.name: Left output
components.job: Line out, left: keeps the codec's DC off the jack

components.name: Right output
components.job: Line out, right: the same circuit as the left

components.name: Codec
components.job: Turns sound into numbers and back; every audio ground meets here

components.name: Codec wires
components.job: Core's header to the codec: its power, I2C, clocks and sound

components.name: Pico link wires
components.job: The UART between Core and the Pico, on header pins 8 and 10

components.name: Core
components.job: Runs the sound engine and the pedal service

components.name: Pico
components.job: Reads the footswitches and controls, and talks to Core

components.name: Core's mains power
components.job: The USB-C adapter that powers Core

components.name: Debug probe
components.job: Watches the Pico or Core, from your computer's USB

tests.name: Codec
tests.line: Power, I2C and clocks: is the codec there and answering?

tests.name: Pico link
tests.line: Is Core talking to the Pico?

tests.name: Debug probe
tests.line: Is the probe's USB plugged into this computer?

tests.name: Left output noise
tests.line: The noise at the left output, with the engine muted

tests.name: Right output noise
tests.line: The same, at the right output (the last session only measured the left)

tests.name: Guitar input noise
tests.line: The noise Core records at the guitar input, with nothing playing

tests.name: Pi on a battery
tests.line: Does the hum follow the Pi's mains adapter?

tests.name: Codec input on its own
tests.line: Is the hiss the guitar input's or the codec's?

pico.check: the Pico's messages arrive on header pin 10
pico.said: No frames have ever arrived on the Core→Pico UART link.

probe.check: the Debug Probe's USB is on the computer running scripts/benchtest
probe.said: The Debug Probe's USB is not on this computer.

codec.name: Codec
codec.summary: The codec is there: it answers on I2C and its clocks reach Core.
codec.evidence: 47 registers; 0x00 left input volume = 0x0117; 0x01 right input volume = 0x0117; 0x02 headphone (LOUT1) volume = 0x0173; 0x03 headphone (ROUT1) volume = 0x0173; 0x04 clocking (1): PLL, SYSCLK = 0x0005; 0x05 DAC control 1 = 0x0000

checks.check: the codec answers on I2C, so its 3V3, SDA and SCL wires are in
checks.said: The driver has the codec bound and its register map is readable.

checks.check: the codec answers on I2C, so its 3V3, SDA and SCL wires are in
checks.said: The driver has the codec bound and its register map is readable.

audio.name: Sound device and engine
audio.summary: The engine has the sound device open and streaming, in the right format.

checks.check: the engine keeps up with the sound device: no xruns
checks.said: The engine reports no xrun issue.

link.name: Pico link
link.summary: No frames have ever arrived on the Core→Pico UART link.
link.evidence: frames_ok=0, link open=True, held by pedald (pid 24087)
link.next: The lead in header pin 10, at both ends.
likely: GP0 to header pin 10 is out: nothing is arriving at all
the Pico has no power (check its own uptime, --probe)
the Pico is in BOOTSEL or has no firmware

checks.check: the Pico's messages arrive on header pin 10
checks.said: No frames have ever arrived on the Core→Pico UART link.

checks.check: the Pico's messages arrive on header pin 10
checks.said: No frames have ever arrived on the Core→Pico UART link.

core.name: Core
core.summary: Core is cool, has memory to spare, and its supply holds up.
core.evidence: the firmware's cooling steps begin at 50.0 C, 60.0 C, 67.5 C, 75.0 C; critical 110.0 C; read from the files this sample

checks.check: Core is below the temperature where it slows itself down
Core's supply holds its voltage: the low-voltage alarm is off

probe.name: Debug probe
probe.summary: The Debug Probe's USB is not on this computer.
probe.next: Plug the Debug Probe's USB into the computer running scripts/benchtest. Its other lead goes to the Pico or to Core's debug header.

checks.said: The Debug Probe's USB is not on this computer.
